title: HTTP/3 Low-Level Malformed Sequence Test Verification
verification_method: Build, focused low-level HTTP/3 tests, requirement-home tests, and SpecTrace validation.
scope: Verify that malformed HTTP/3 sequences normal clients do not generate are documented, mapped to expected RFC 9114 error outcomes, and covered by automated custom-client tests.
expected_result: The build passes, every malformed sequence produces the expected HTTP/3 error code or explicit no-error ignored outcome, the requirement-home proof passes, and SpecTrace validation accepts the new artifacts.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
2026-05-25: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/Validate-SpecTraceJson.ps1 -RepoRoot . -Profiles core` validated 604 SpecTrace JSON artifacts.
2026-06-10: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

2026-06-10: focused HTTP/3/QPACK test filter covering `Http3StreamDispatcherTests`, `Http3LowLevelProtocolTests`, `Http3QPackErrorHandlingMatrixTests`, frame, SETTINGS, header, QPACK milestone/instruction, and RFC 9114/RFC 9204 requirement-home tests passed 229/229.

2026-06-10: the touched RFC 9114 SpecTrace JSON artifacts passed direct `Test-Json` schema validation; full `Validate-SpecTraceJson.ps1 -Profiles core` remained blocked by unrelated RFC 9250 artifact errors and is not claimed as positive evidence for this slice.
status_summary: Passed for deterministic low-level RFC 9114 malformed sequence classification and documentation, including client-sent and unadvertised PUSH_PROMISE handling. The proof is layer-local and does not claim live h3i wire behavior or complete RFC 9114/RFC 9204 support.
